name: D7 explicit nested pair-curve memorization audit
purpose: test whether explicit balanced curve reconstruction fixes the nested consequence failure of aggregate D3 supervision
scope: TRAIN-only same-example mechanism diagnostic; cannot authorize DEV, TEST, deployment, or visual transfer

data.selection: same first state and first nested group per episode as D6 audits

model.backbone: unchanged set-conditioned D6 at the passed add_commitment stage
model.head: symmetric endpoint-pair MLP over permutation-equivariant backbone tokens
model.outputs: log1p early/full normalized gaps and a 39-sample whole-trajectory separation curve per nested level
model.curve_monitor: unchanged calibration-free boundary, commitment, and persistence rules applied directly to predicted curves

optimization.batching: deterministic full batch of all eight groups and six levels
optimization.loss: equal sum of five group-level balanced MSE terms

frozen_gates.complete_same_example_gate: all curve gates plus candidate and partition agreement equal 1.0

comparison.decision: explicit curve formulation passes only if it exactly recovers nested boundary and final decisions without degrading the frozen backbone neighborhood
